title: Let Three Services Read the Same Events
description: Billing, analytics and search each need every order event at their own pace. Analytics must replay yesterday after a bug fix. Which setup fits?

options.text: One destructive work queue shared by all three services.
options.explanation: Competing consumers split tasks; acknowledging removes messages rather than retaining them for each independent application.

options.text: A cache containing only the most recent event.
options.explanation: One current value cannot provide every event or yesterday's history.

options.text: A retained log with one consumer group per service.
options.explanation: Each group tracks its own offsets and receives the records independently. Retention must cover the required replay window.

options.text: One consumer group with one worker from each service.
options.explanation: Within a group, partitions are divided among workers. That would not give every service every event.
